calculate_jaccard_for_segment: compute Jaccard similarity for a single track segment given predicted and ground truth track and visibility tensors with a distance threshold
count_consecutive_invisibility: count consecutive invisible frames ending at the previous timestep for each point in a batch of visibility tensors
compute_raw_redetection_stats: compute raw redetection statistics for eligible reappearance events including indices, durations, and AJ_RD scores per distance threshold
compute_redetection_metrics: compute AJ_RD redetection metrics for predicted and ground truth point tracks across multiple distance and minimum duration thresholds
build_aj_rd_metric_pipeline: build a pipeline to evaluate point track redetection accuracy using AJ_RD metrics with configurable distance and duration thresholds
